transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, I'm here because I'm having a really hard time with my eating. 

What really scares me is that once I start eating... especially when I’m alone in the kitchen... it feels like I’ve just stepped aside. I can’t make myself stop. Even though I’m telling myself the whole time, you know, ‘Janet, put it away,’ I just keep going. It's really bothering me, and I just need some help figuring it out.
After these episodes, do you ever try to make up for the eating by vomiting, fasting, exercising excessively, or using laxatives?

No, I don't do any of that. Um, I've never made myself throw up or taken laxatives or anything. And I definitely don't exercise to work it off. I mostly just... sit there feeling awful about what I just did, but no, I don't do anything to try and undo it.
How often do these episodes of feeling unable to stop eating happen?

Um, looking back at my kitchen calendar and, you know, keeping track of my food bank weeks... I'd say they've been happening most weeks. Usually it's about once or twice a week. And it's been going on like that for many months now.
During these episodes, do you eat an amount of food that is unusually large compared with what most people would eat in similar circumstances?

Yes, I do. Um, for example, on some afternoons after my shift at the food bank, or if I've been baking for an event at the senior center, I’ll come home and just... keep eating. I’ll have a full plate of leftovers, and then I'll eat slices of banana bread, a bunch of chips, some cheese, and just whatever cookies are sitting in the tin. Afterward, when I really think about it, I realize it was way more food than any normal meal I’d ever serve to another person.
During these episodes, do you usually eat much more quickly than you normally would?

Yes, I do. I catch myself eating so fast that I barely even taste the food. Like, I'll just be standing at the kitchen counter taking bite after bite of a casserole or muffins I made. It's almost like I'm in a huge hurry, even when I'm just at home and there's nowhere I need to be.
